Security Solutions

                          
Fast and frictionless airport security screening
                    
      
    
  
  
    

  

    

  
  

        

    
                                  

INTEGRATED AND EFFICIENT SECURITY SCREENING
Leidos is a global leader in advanced security screening technologies, offering a comprehensive portfolio of automated and integrated solutions. We deliver fast, frictionless and fully integrated solutions to help secure the movement of people, baggage and parcels at airports worldwide.

            Leidos Security Enterprise Solutions and Analogic partner to form American joint venture
